app.title: Simple Shot Timer
home.noShotsHint: Nothing was saved. Adjust sensitivity or add a shot by hand.
home.beepInaudible: Media volume is off. Beeps will be silent.
history.title: History
history.clearConfirmBody: This will permanently delete every saved string.
review.title: Review
review.label: Label
review.differentVideoBody: This video doesn’t look like the one this string was made from. Open it anyway?
settings.title: Settings
settings.deleteAllConfirmBody:
This deletes every saved string, custom drill and setting from this device. It can't be undone.

To restore only the default settings and keep your strings and drills, choose Reset settings only.
settings.deleteAllFailed: Couldn't delete everything. Please try again.
settings.beepLatencyOffsetHint: Extra delay subtracted from shot times for output the mic can't hear itself, e.g. Bluetooth earbuds. Leave at 0 to rely on automatic beep calibration.
settings.testMicSubtitle: Live level meter to dial in sensitivity
settings.historyHint: Oldest strings are deleted automatically once the cap is exceeded.
settings.legalese: Free software under the GNU GPL v3 with additional terms, provided without any warranty. The license texts are under "simple_shot_timer" further down the list. Source code: {url}
drills.saveCurrentHint: Stores drill mode, start delay and par/stage values
drills.nameExists: A drill with this name already exists
drills.overwriteBody: A drill named “{name}” already exists. Replace it with the current settings?
drills.deleteBody: “{name}” will be removed. Your current settings are not changed.
drills.empty: No saved drills yet. Save your current drill to reuse it in one tap.
micTest.title: Test microphone
micTest.instruction: Make the noise you want to detect. The red line is the current detection threshold — adjust sensitivity until peaks just cross it.
settings.bandFilterHint: Only count sounds whose energy sits in the band below — rejects rumble, hiss, and most non-shot noise.
settings.autoConfigSubtitle: Fire a few shots and let the app tune sensitivity and frequency band for your gear.
autoConfig.title: Auto-configure
autoConfig.instruction: Tap Start, fire several shots with your usual ammo and stance, then tap Stop. The app will suggest a sensitivity and frequency band tuned to what it heard.
autoConfig.empty: No shots captured yet. Tap Start to begin.
autoConfig.tapToAdjust: Tap a capture to include or exclude it.
autoConfig.noneSelected: No captures selected. Tap one to include it.
micTest.tip: Tip: gunshots typically saturate the mic (~95–100%). Indoor claps usually land 5–30%. Pick a sensitivity that puts the red line just below the lowest peak you want to capture, well above the loudest sound you want to ignore.
errors.saveFailed: Could not save the string. Add a shot to try again.
video.title: Video
video.empty: Film a string with your phone. The app finds the beep and every shot, and you check them.
video.privacy: The video stays on this phone.
video.problem.title: Can’t use this video
video.problem.noSound: This video has no sound, so the beep and shots can’t be heard.
video.problem.slowMotion: This is a slow-motion video. Its sound is missing or slowed down.
video.problem.timeLapse: This is a time-lapse video, which has no usable sound.
video.problem.unreadableSound: This phone can’t read the sound of this video.
video.problem.unsupportedVideo: This file isn’t a video this phone can play.
video.problem.unreadableFile: The video couldn’t be read. It may have been moved or deleted.
video.problem.tooShort: This video is too short for a string.
video.problem.noSpace: Your phone’s storage is full. Free up some space and try again.
video.problem.failed: Something went wrong while opening this video. Try again.
part.title: Choose the part
part.scanning: Videos over 3 minutes are checked 3 minutes at a time. Finding the loudest part…
part.hint: Videos over 3 minutes are checked 3 minutes at a time. Move the frame over your string.
export.title: Export video
export.keepOpen: Keep Simple Shot Timer open until it finishes.
export.noAccess: Simple Shot Timer isn’t allowed to save videos. You can still share it.
export.saveFailed: The video couldn’t be saved to Photos. You can still share it.
export.noSpace: There isn’t enough free space to export the video. Free up some space and try again.
editor.title: Check shots
editor.noStart: No beep found. Play to the beep and tap Set START.
editor.discardBody: It will be removed from your history.
editor.saveFailedBody: This string couldn’t be saved. Try again, or discard it.
editor.leaveBody: A string is saved once it has START and at least one shot.
editor.discardFailed: The string couldn’t be deleted. Try again.
editor.saveFailedExport: This string couldn’t be saved. Try again, or export the video without saving it.
